meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: Claude 会以编排者身份,先派子代理去搜集文档、示例和真实可用的 API,再产出分阶段的实现计划,每阶段附文档引用与验证清单。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个功能、任务或多步实现时触发,尤其在用 do 执行之前。

say.text: 帮我为这个功能做一份分阶段实现计划
say.note: 会先做 Phase 0 文档发现,再写计划

say.text: 规划前先查一下相关文档和可用 API
say.note: 它会派子代理搜集文档来源并列出允许使用的 API

say.text: 给这个任务写计划,每阶段都要验证清单
say.note: 计划末尾还有整体验证阶段

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an orchestrator: it first deploys subagents to gather docs, examples and the real available APIs, then writes a phased implementation plan with doc references and a verification checklist per phase.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Make a phased implementation plan for this feature
Check the docs and available APIs before planning
say_en.note: Deploys subagents to gather sources and an allowed-APIs list

say_en.text: Write the plan with a verification checklist per phase
say_en.note: Ends with a final verification phase
